premiere-pro.name: connection_status
premiere-pro.description: Check the local bridge for Premiere Pro; works without Adobe connected.

premiere-pro.name: get_app_info
premiere-pro.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

premiere-pro.name: get_project
premiere-pro.description: Read the open Premiere Pro project.

premiere-pro.name: list_sequences
premiere-pro.description: List project sequences and their IDs.

premiere-pro.name: activate_sequence
premiere-pro.description: Open a sequence in the timeline by sequence ID.

premiere-pro.name: list_project_items
premiere-pro.description: Read a paginated flattened project bin tree with node IDs.

premiere-pro.name: create_bin
premiere-pro.description: Create a root-level project bin.

premiere-pro.name: import_media
premiere-pro.description: Import local media into the project root, suppressing import dialogs.

premiere-pro.name: create_sequence_from_clips
premiere-pro.description: Create a sequence from project-item node IDs.

premiere-pro.name: get_timeline
premiere-pro.description: Read clips on a video or audio track of the active sequence. Track index starts at zero.

premiere-pro.name: insert_clip
premiere-pro.description: Insert a project item on a track at a time in seconds. Inserting can ripple the timeline.

premiere-pro.name: add_marker
premiere-pro.description: Add a comment marker to the active sequence at seconds.

premiere-pro.name: save_project
premiere-pro.description: Save the current Premiere project in place.

premiere-pro.name: export_sequence
premiere-pro.description: Export the active sequence directly using a local .epr preset. This waits for the native export call.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

premiere-pro.name: get_sequence_settings
premiere-pro.description: Read active sequence video dimensions, timebase, frame duration, playhead and in/out points.

premiere-pro.name: list_markers
premiere-pro.description: Read a paginated list of active sequence markers, including GUIDs and start/end times in seconds.

premiere-pro.name: set_playhead
premiere-pro.description: Move the active sequence playhead to an absolute time in seconds.

premiere-pro.name: set_sequence_range
premiere-pro.description: Set active sequence in/out points in seconds; end must be greater than start.

premiere-pro.name: set_clip_enabled
premiere-pro.description: Enable or disable a timeline clip. Track and clip indexes start at zero; requires TrackItem.disabled support.

premiere-pro.name: relink_media
premiere-pro.description: Replace a project item source file by node ID. All clips referencing that item are affected.

premiere-pro.name: run_script
premiere-pro.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

photoshop.name: connection_status
photoshop.description: Check the local bridge for Photoshop; works without Adobe connected.

photoshop.name: get_app_info
photoshop.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

photoshop.name: list_documents
photoshop.description: List open Photoshop documents; IDs and dimensions are in pixels.

photoshop.name: open_document
photoshop.description: Open an existing image or PSD file.

photoshop.name: create_document
photoshop.description: Create an RGB document with a transparent background. Dimensions are pixels.

photoshop.name: activate_document
photoshop.description: Make an open document active by ID.

photoshop.name: list_layers
photoshop.description: Read a paginated flattened layer tree in the active document.

photoshop.name: create_layer
photoshop.description: Add an empty art layer to the active document.

photoshop.name: set_layer
photoshop.description: Set layer name, visibility and opacity by layer ID.

photoshop.name: add_text
photoshop.description: Create a text layer. Position is [x,y] in pixels and font size is points.

photoshop.name: resize_image
photoshop.description: Resize the active image to explicit pixel dimensions.

photoshop.name: save_document
photoshop.description: Save the active document to its current file. Unsaved documents must use save_as_psd.

photoshop.name: save_as_psd
photoshop.description: Save the active document as PSD, preserving layers.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

photoshop.name: export_image
photoshop.description: Export a PNG or JPEG copy. The output extension must match the selected format.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

photoshop.name: get_document_info
photoshop.description: Read active Photoshop document dimensions, color mode, bit depth and active layer.

photoshop.name: duplicate_document
photoshop.description: Duplicate the active document, preserve its layers, and activate the copy.

photoshop.name: duplicate_layer
photoshop.description: Duplicate a layer or group by ID within the active document.

photoshop.name: translate_layer
photoshop.description: Move a layer or group by a relative offset in pixels, independent of ruler preferences.

photoshop.name: set_text_layer
photoshop.description: Replace text and optionally its font size in points, using a text layer ID. Empty text clears the layer.

photoshop.name: crop_document
photoshop.description: Crop the active document to [left,top,right,bottom] pixel bounds inside the current canvas.

photoshop.name: run_script
photoshop.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

media-encoder.name: connection_status
media-encoder.description: Check the local bridge for Media Encoder; works without Adobe connected.

media-encoder.name: get_app_info
media-encoder.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

media-encoder.name: get_batch_status
media-encoder.description: Read batch running state and status (detailed status requires AME 23.3+).

media-encoder.name: list_import_types
media-encoder.description: List supported source media file types.

media-encoder.name: add_to_queue
media-encoder.description: Queue one source file with an explicit output path and .epr preset. Queue acceptance does not mean encoding is complete.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

media-encoder.name: list_dynamic_link_items
media-encoder.description: Read root composition/sequence GUIDs from an AEP or Premiere project.

media-encoder.name: add_dynamic_link_to_queue
media-encoder.description: Queue a composition/sequence using its GUID, project path and preset.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

media-encoder.name: start_batch
media-encoder.description: Start or resume the Media Encoder batch. Returns immediately; use get_batch_status for progress.

media-encoder.name: stop_batch
media-encoder.description: Stop the batch. An in-progress output may be incomplete.

media-encoder.name: inspect_source
media-encoder.description: Inspect readable primitive source-media metadata exposed by the installed AME version. Property names are discovered through reflection.

media-encoder.name: add_image_sequence
media-encoder.description: Queue an image sequence using a folder and one image in that folder. Other images with the same extension may be included by AME.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

media-encoder.name: stitch_files
media-encoder.description: Queue multiple media files as one stitched output in the supplied order. Source paths cannot contain semicolons.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

media-encoder.name: save_batch_preview
media-encoder.description: Write the current batch preview to a TIFF file. A current preview must be available.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

media-encoder.name: run_script
media-encoder.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

illustrator.name: connection_status
illustrator.description: Check the local bridge for Illustrator; works without Adobe connected.

illustrator.name: get_app_info
illustrator.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

illustrator.name: list_documents
illustrator.description: List open Illustrator documents with one-based indexes.

illustrator.name: open_document
illustrator.description: Open an Illustrator-compatible local file.

illustrator.name: create_document
illustrator.description: Create an RGB document. Dimensions are points; Illustrator assigns the initial name.

illustrator.name: activate_document
illustrator.description: Activate a document using its one-based index.

illustrator.name: list_layers
illustrator.description: List top-level layers in the active document.

illustrator.name: create_layer
illustrator.description: Create a named layer in the active document.

illustrator.name: list_artboards
illustrator.description: Read artboard rectangles [left,top,right,bottom] in points.

illustrator.name: add_artboard
illustrator.description: Add an artboard using [left,top,right,bottom] points.

illustrator.name: add_rectangle
illustrator.description: Draw a filled rectangle. Coordinates and dimensions are points.

illustrator.name: add_text
illustrator.description: Create point text at [x,y] in points.

illustrator.name: save_as_ai
illustrator.description: Save the active Illustrator document as AI.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

illustrator.name: export_svg
illustrator.description: Export the active document as SVG.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

illustrator.name: export_png
illustrator.description: Export PNG24 with artboard clipping. Scale is a percentage.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

illustrator.name: get_selection
illustrator.description: Read selected Illustrator objects with bounded text previews. Text selections are supported.

illustrator.name: set_layer
illustrator.description: Rename, show, hide, lock or unlock a top-level Illustrator layer by one-based index.

illustrator.name: activate_artboard
illustrator.description: Activate an artboard by one-based index.

illustrator.name: add_ellipse
illustrator.description: Draw a filled ellipse. Position and dimensions are points; RGB components range from zero to one.

illustrator.name: place_image
illustrator.description: Place a linked local image at [x,y] points using its natural size.

illustrator.name: save_as_pdf
illustrator.description: Save the active Illustrator document as PDF. This changes its current file association.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

illustrator.name: run_script
illustrator.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

indesign.name: connection_status
indesign.description: Check the local bridge for InDesign; works without Adobe connected.

indesign.name: get_app_info
indesign.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

indesign.name: list_documents
indesign.description: List open InDesign documents.

indesign.name: open_document
indesign.description: Open an existing InDesign document.

indesign.name: create_document
indesign.description: Create a document with dimensions in points.

indesign.name: list_pages
indesign.description: Read page names and text-frame counts.

indesign.name: add_page
indesign.description: Append one page to the active document.

indesign.name: add_text_frame
indesign.description: Add a text frame. Bounds [top,left,bottom,right] use points in the current ruler origin.

indesign.name: list_text_frames
indesign.description: Read text frame IDs and contents on a page.

indesign.name: set_text
indesign.description: Replace contents of a text frame by ID.

indesign.name: place_image
indesign.description: Place a local image into a new rectangular frame and fit proportionally.

indesign.name: save_as
indesign.description: Save the active document as INDD.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

indesign.name: list_pdf_presets
indesign.description: List installed PDF export preset names.

indesign.name: export_pdf
indesign.description: Export PDF, optionally using an installed preset name.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

indesign.name: activate_document
indesign.description: Activate an open InDesign document by its document ID.

indesign.name: get_document_info
indesign.description: Read active document identity, page/story/link counts, saved state and unsaved changes.

indesign.name: list_links
indesign.description: List placed-file links, IDs, paths and native status values in the active document.

indesign.name: update_link
indesign.description: Refresh one placed-file link by ID. The linked source must still exist.

indesign.name: export_idml
indesign.description: Export an IDML interchange copy without changing the current INDD file association.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

indesign.name: run_script
indesign.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

after-effects.name: connection_status
after-effects.description: Check the local bridge for After Effects; works without Adobe connected.

after-effects.name: get_app_info
after-effects.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

after-effects.name: get_project
after-effects.description: Read current After Effects project information.

after-effects.name: open_project
after-effects.description: Open an existing AEP project. Refuse if another project is already open with items.

after-effects.name: save_project_as
after-effects.description: Save the current project as an AEP file.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

after-effects.name: list_items
after-effects.description: List project items with one-based indexes and stable item IDs.

after-effects.name: import_file
after-effects.description: Import a local media file into the project.

after-effects.name: create_composition
after-effects.description: Create a composition with pixel dimensions and duration in seconds.

after-effects.name: list_layers
after-effects.description: Read layers of a composition, with one-based layer indexes.

after-effects.name: add_text
after-effects.description: Add a text layer to a composition.

after-effects.name: add_solid
after-effects.description: Add a full-frame solid layer with RGB values from zero to one.

after-effects.name: add_footage_layer
after-effects.description: Add an existing project footage or composition item to a composition.

after-effects.name: set_transform
after-effects.description: Set static 2D position, scale, rotation and opacity. Existing keyframes cause Adobe to reject static changes.

after-effects.name: set_opacity_keyframe
after-effects.description: Set an opacity keyframe at a time in seconds.

after-effects.name: add_to_render_queue
after-effects.description: Queue a composition for rendering using existing Render Settings / Output Module template names.

overwrite.description: Explicitly permit replacing an existing output file

after-effects.name: list_render_queue
after-effects.description: Read queued render items and their native status values.

after-effects.name: render_queue
after-effects.description: Render all enabled queued items synchronously. This can take a long time; configure ADOBE_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS accordingly.

after-effects.name: get_composition
after-effects.description: Read composition size, frame rate, duration, layer count and work area by project item index.

after-effects.name: set_work_area
after-effects.description: Set a composition work area in seconds. Duration must be at least one frame and fit inside the composition.

after-effects.name: add_composition_marker
after-effects.description: Add a composition marker at seconds; an existing marker at that time requires replaceExisting=true.

after-effects.name: duplicate_layer
after-effects.description: Duplicate a layer within a composition and optionally rename the copy.

after-effects.name: set_layer_timing
after-effects.description: Set layer in/out points in composition seconds and optionally its start-time offset.

after-effects.name: add_effect
after-effects.description: Add an effect by its stable Adobe match name to a layer. Unsupported effects are rejected before insertion.

after-effects.name: set_transform_keyframe
after-effects.description: Set a 2D transform keyframe. Position/scale use two numbers; rotation/opacity use one number.

after-effects.name: get_render_templates
after-effects.description: Read Render Settings and Output Module template names from an existing render-queue item.

after-effects.name: run_script
after-effects.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.

audition.name: connection_status
audition.description: Check the local bridge for Audition; works without Adobe connected.

audition.name: get_app_info
audition.description: Read the connected Adobe application name and version.

audition.name: list_commands
audition.description: Discover actual Audition command IDs and help from the installed version. Filter before invoking commands.

audition.name: is_command_enabled
audition.description: Check whether an Audition command ID is enabled in the current workspace.

audition.name: invoke_command
audition.description: Invoke an enabled Audition command discovered with list_commands. It may modify audio or open a native dialog.

audition.name: get_active_document
audition.description: Read active document type; waveform timing is in samples and seconds.

audition.name: set_playhead
audition.description: Move the waveform playhead to an absolute time in seconds.

audition.name: inspect_api
audition.description: Read reflected property and method names from Audition to discover version-specific scripting capabilities.

audition.name: seek_playhead
audition.description: Move the waveform playhead by a relative number of seconds. Optional clamping keeps it within waveform bounds.

audition.name: get_api_member
audition.description: Read type, help and argument metadata for one reflected Audition property or method without invoking it.

audition.name: invoke_commands
audition.description: Invoke up to 20 discovered command IDs in order. Stops on the first disabled or failing command and returns completed commands; index values start at zero. Avoid commands that open dialogs.

audition.name: run_script
audition.description: Execute arbitrary ExtendScript with full Adobe scripting permissions. Return a plain JSON-compatible value using return. No browser or Node APIs.
